summary: All required fields are present, applicant name and Aadhaar number are consistent across documents, sanction details align with the request, community consent is formal and signed, and the timeline is coherent.

checks.name: Applicant Name Consistency Across Documents

checks.name: Identification Number Verification
checks.evidence: Application ID 'AADHAAR-8921-4321-9988' matches Aadhaar number '8921-4321-9988' in identity proof

checks.name: Community Consent Document Formality
checks.evidence: Document includes resolution number, meeting date 2026-03-10, clear consent statement, and signatures of two residents plus Panchayat Secretary attestation

checks.name: Sanction Document Alignment

checks.reason: Timeline is logical and no inconsistencies found
